notes: BEVCO Lifting: the 12 / 24 in the CASE box can now be typed. Every line carries its own bottles-per-case (24 for beer and breezer, 12 for liquor, 1 for a keg to start with) — change it to 6, 48 or anything else and only that line follows. Correcting the pack size never changes the bottles or the money; the case count is what follows. Empty the box to go back to the figure for that category.
